description: గోదావరిలో మేడిగడ్డ మీదుగా వందలాది టీఎంసీల నీటిని వృథాగా వదిలేసిన కాంగ్రెస్‌ సర్కార్‌.. ‘చేతులు కాలాక ఆకులు పట్టుకున్న’ చందంగా, ఇప్పుడు తమ నిర్లక్ష్యాన్ని కప్పిపుచ్చుకోవడానికి ‘ఎల్‌ నినో’ను బూచిగా చూపిస్తున్నది. కరువు సాకుతో యాసంగిలో పంటలు వేయవద్దంటూ రైతుల పొట్టలు కొట్టేందుకు సిద్ధమైంది.

description: ప్రధాని మోదీ స్వరాష్ట్రం గుజరాత్‌లో చీకట్లు కమ్ముకున్నాయి. తీవ్ర విద్యుత్తు సంక్షోభంతో రాష్ట్రం అల్లాడిపోతున్నది. కరెంటు కోతలతో ప్రజలు తీవ్ర అవస్థలు పడుతున్నారు. పెరుగుతున్న విద్యుత్తు డిమాండ్‌, బొగ్గు కొరత, తగ్గిన పవన విద్యుదుత్పత్తి, జలవిద్యుత్తు ఉత్పత్తికి అవసరమైన నీటి నిల్వలు తగ్గిపోవడం వంటి పరిణామాలు రాష్ట్రంలో విద్యుత్తు సరఫరాపై ఒత్తిడిని పెంచుతున్నాయి.

title: అనుముల భూదోపిడీకి.. ఆయుధంగా 22a
description: ‘అధికారాన్ని అడ్డంపెట్టుకోవాలి. తద్వారా రూ. కోట్ల విలువైన భూములను యథేచ్ఛగా దోచుకోవాలి. ఇందుకు కాదేదీ అనర్హం అన్నట్టు.. చివరకు 22ఏ నిషేధిత జాబితాను కూడా ఓ ఆయుధంగా మలుచుకోవాలి. ముఖ్యమంత్రి రేవంత్‌ కుటుంబం చేస్తున్నదిదే’ అని బీఆర్‌ఎస్‌ అధికార ప్రతినిధి, మినరల్‌ డెవలప్‌మెంట్‌ కార్పొరేషన్‌ మాజీ చైర్మన్‌ మన్నె క్రిశాంక్‌ విమర్శించారు.

title: US stocks today: Nasdaq leads Wall Street gains as chip, AI stocks rebound
description: US stocks ended mixed on Monday, with the Nasdaq leading gains as chip and AI-linked stocks bounced back after last week’s sharp selloff. Investors also tracked corporate earnings and fresh stock-specific moves, while concerns over AI spending and financing remained in focus.

title: Hedge funds retreat from tech at fastest pace in a decade as AI trade weakens
description: Hedge funds cut technology exposure at the fastest pace in at least a decade as the global AI trade weakened and tech stocks bore the brunt of last week’s selloff. Goldman Sachs data showed funds reduced risk sharply, although technology remained a major part of their portfolios.

title: S&P Global flags potentially hidden AI debt at hyperscalers as AI spending surges
description: S&P Global warned that hyperscalers could be carrying more AI related debt than currently visible through financing structures linked to data centres and smaller AI firms. Despite rising concerns around AI infrastructure debt, the agency saw no immediate need for rating changes, while flagging profitability and escalating investment as key risks.

title: Jio IPO: LIC, BlackRock, Fidelity, GIC among 212 anchor investors to pour Rs 8,110 crore
description: Jio Platforms successfully raised approximately Rs 8,110 crore from 212 anchor investors before its upcoming IPO. The company allotted shares to well-known investors such as LIC, BlackRock, and Fidelity. These allocations indicate strong interest from both domestic and global institutional investors. The IPO is expected to surpass the previous record held by Hyundai Motor India. Jio Platforms aims to achieve an equity valuation of nearly Rs 10.3 lakh crore.

title: AI stocks rebound as CoreWeave jumps on Goldman Sachs upgrade
description: AI stocks rebound after last week’s sharp selloff, with semiconductor stocks leading the recovery. CoreWeave gains after Goldman Sachs upgrades the stock to buy, while Intel, Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom also rise. Investors now turn to upcoming technology earnings for clues on AI spending, valuations, debt and interest rates.

title: Ireda net profit grows to Rs 554 cr in Sep qtr
description: Ireda has announced a net profit of Rs 554 crore for the September quarter of FY27, reflecting a robust financial performance. Revenue from operations increased by 14%, totaling Rs 2,345 crore. Additionally, loan disbursements surged by 31%, reaching Rs 10,579 crore. This quarter also marked an 11% rise in net worth, showcasing Ireda's strength in renewable energy financing and management of asset quality.

title: Amazon says its AI chips will work with popular coding language, challenging Nvidia
description: Amazon has unveiled TorchNeuron, a revolutionary tool that enables PyTorch code to be executed seamlessly on its Trainium AI chips. This innovation claims to minimize the need for extensive code alterations, making integration easier for developers. Over 30 early adopters have attested to remarkable cost efficiencies, prompting industry giants like Nvidia and Google to amp up their own offerings.

title: Global Markets: French markets tumble as riots add to political crisis
description: Protests across France have led to significant declines in the country's financial markets and stocks. French government officials requested local authorities to consider imposing curfews amid the unrest. The rise in bond yields suggests increasing investor concern over France's budgetary challenges and economic outlook. Major French banks have experienced stock declines, reflecting the heightened risk of insuring French debt.

title: US Treasury yields nudge higher as AI fears ebb
description: US Treasury yields experienced a rise alongside a boost in equities, particularly driven by AI stocks, which has mitigated earlier anxieties among investors. The 10-year Treasury yield saw a modest rebound after a steep decline, indicating a shift in market mood. Moreover, oil prices declined, easing inflation fears related to global tensions.

title: Bajaj Finance Q2 consolidated net profit rises 29% to Rs 6,367 crore
description: Bajaj Finance expects AUM to grow 26-27% in FY27 as it accelerates customer acquisition and loan disbursements. The lender plans to book 60-62 million new loans and add 18-20 million customers during the year. Consolidated AUM grew 26% to Rs 5.85 lakh crore in the September quarter, aided by broad-based loan growth. The gold-loan portfolio more than doubled to Rs 24,195 crore, although short-tenor schemes caused a transitional increase in Stage 2 assets. Management does not expect this movement
